source: Final72 frozen V1.1 prototype plus validated evidence reconstruction

hypotheses.statement: Semantic-only apparent strength may attenuate under a lexically difficult unified official-evidence corpus.
hypotheses.basis: S-only AUROC 0.623 vs Full 0.647; prior query robustness found material lexical-overlap dependence and no lexically similar irrelevant distractor at its frozen threshold.
hypotheses.formal_test: Predeclare query variants and hard official distractors; compare group-isolated S-only to SEPT on untouched scale test.

hypotheses.statement: Temporal benefit requires observable current/history binding, version relations and effective intervals; historicalness alone may cause HN errors.
hypotheses.basis: T-only P>HN is 2 wins, 20 ties, 2 losses; adding T reduces P-HN margin in 17/24 groups; PTS V3 computes in 10/40 temporal-applicable samples.
hypotheses.formal_test: Freeze complete provenance-backed temporal metadata and predeclare HN-FPR and matched P>HN tests.

hypotheses.statement: Provenance benefit may require candidate-bound issuer/publisher/host/authority relations and source-role variation.
hypotheses.basis: Three of six P features are constant; two relations are deferred; P-only has 20/24 matched ties despite adding P increasing P-HN margin in 19 groups.
hypotheses.formal_test: Measure relation coverage and P view variance by domain/class before model freeze; then evaluate on an independent group-aware test.

hypotheses.statement: Multiview effects may vary by HKP and stealth rather than showing uniform average gain.
hypotheses.basis: Final72 full P>HN is 5/6 for HKP1-3 but 3/6 for HKP4; S3 full is 5/8. Small development strata cannot establish a trend.
hypotheses.formal_test: Prespecify HKP1-4 and S1-3 stratified matched outcomes with sufficient independent chains.

hypotheses.statement: Hard negatives must be source-backed and lexically/structurally close to poison, with current/history near-duplicate and same-authority distractors.
hypotheses.basis: Six Final72 groups do not rank Poison above HN; the current 57-document corpus lacks frozen-threshold lexical hard distractors.
hypotheses.formal_test: Construct balanced hard negatives and audit fact validity, version role and difficulty before formal split.
